meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要从命令行制作演示动画
copy.tagline_en: Create and render presentation animations from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to build presentations programmatically.

howto.what: 使用 HyperFrames CLI 工具链来制作视频：初始化项目、编写内容、运行检查、预览，并能渲染出视频文件，支持本地、云端等不同渲染方式。诊断构建或渲染失败时也会用它。
howto.when: 当你要求制作视频、使用 HyperFrames 开发流程（如初始化、检查、预览、渲染），或排查构建/渲染失败时。

say.text: 帮我用 HyperFrames 新建一个视频项目
say.note: 会运行 init 创建项目骨架

say.text: 检查这个视频项目有没有问题
say.note: 会运行 check 做最终检查

say.text: 把项目渲染成高清的 out.mp4
say.note: 会运行 render 输出视频

howto.what_en: Claude uses the HyperFrames CLI toolchain to produce videos: initializing projects, authoring content, running checks, previewing, and rendering video files, locally or in the cloud. Also used when diagnosing build or render failures.
howto.when_en: When you ask to create a video, use the HyperFrames development loop (init, check, preview, render, etc.), or troubleshoot build/render failures.

say_en.text: Create a new video project with HyperFrames.
say_en.note: Runs init to scaffold the project.

say_en.text: Check this video project for issues.
say_en.note: Runs check for the final gate.

say_en.text: Render the project to a high-quality out.mp4.
